description: Build a sequential backtest system with three cleanly separated components (data handler, engine, strategy) that architecturally prevents look-ahead bias, and include a verification test that proves no future data leaks.
agent_prompt: Build a backtest system in /workspace/src/ for BTCUSDT hourly data at /workspace/data/BTCUSDT_1h_2023_2024.csv. The system must have three cleanly separated components: (1) a data handler that loads the CSV and replays bars sequentially through a controlled interface that does not expose future bars; (2) an engine that manages positions, tracks PnL, and computes performance metrics; (3) a dual-MA crossover strategy module (fast=20, slow=50) that consumes only the current and prior bars exposed by the data handler. Implement an RSI(14) mean-reversion variant of the strategy as well. Write a verification test at /workspace/tests/test_no_lookahead.py that programmatically proves the strategy cannot access bars beyond the current replay index (e.g. by feeding a corrupted future window and asserting the signal is unchanged). Run both strategies end-to-end and write outputs to /workspace/output/: ma_crossover_metrics.json and rsi_meanrev_metrics.json (each with total_return, sharpe, max_drawdown, n_trades), trade_log_ma.csv, trade_log_rsi.csv, and verification_report.json describing the lookahead check result.

required_capabilities: Design a data handler that loads CSV data and provides a sequential bar replay interface
Build a backtest engine with position tracking and PnL computation
Implement strategy modules decoupled from the engine that only access current and past bars
Compute RSI incrementally on the available-so-far window only
Write a verification test that programmatically proves no look-ahead exists
Produce performance summaries for each strategy
